metadata.title: The Proof Foundry — Useful software, on your terms
metadata.description: Independent local-first software for Windows and Android. Explore clipboard tools, reversible cleanup, nightly shutdown, weather and build control.

metadata.title: Page Not Found — The Proof Foundry
metadata.description: This Proof Foundry page could not be found. Explore our software or return to the homepage.

metadata.title: Proof Foundry Receipts — Proof-first software forged for builders
metadata.description: Public proof for what we ship: routes, releases, checksums, receipts, and verification status.

metadata.title: Reality Gate — Run your work. Own the outcome. | The Proof Foundry
metadata.description: Run builds in isolated local workspaces, follow execution in the Runroom, and keep signed receipts. Reality Gate Developer Pilot for Windows.

metadata.title: ForgeCast — Make a plan for outside. | The Proof Foundry
metadata.description: Android weather for the decisions you actually make: when to go outside, what to wear and what to bring. ForgeCast public v0.3.5.

metadata.title: Cache Vault — Keep the things you copy. | The Proof Foundry
metadata.description: A local clipboard vault for Windows with searchable history, collections and Quick Paste. Public v0.2.2; v0.2.3-rc1 is a release candidate.

metadata.title: Founders Circle — The Proof Foundry™
metadata.description: The Founders Circle: 100 founding receipts for the first builders to back Proof Foundry products. Real entries are added only after claim.

metadata.title: Cleanroom — Less clutter. A way back. | The Proof Foundry
metadata.description: Review Windows cleanup candidates, archive selected files and restore them to their original paths. Cleanroom public v1.0.7; next build v1.0.10.

metadata.title: ProofShot — Keep the context with the capture. | The Proof Foundry
metadata.description: An in-development Windows workbench for page resources, evidence bundles and offline verification. No public ProofShot release; underlying engine v1.6.18.

metadata.title: Lights Out — Give your night a gentle ending. | The Proof Foundry
metadata.description: Plan a Windows shutdown or sleep timer, then pause, snooze or cancel from your Android companion. Public Windows v11.1.2; v11.1.3 candidates are on hold.

metadata.title: GhostLayer — Choose what becomes permanent. | The Proof Foundry
metadata.description: Stage files in a volatile RAM layer, open them for editing, and deliberately commit selected changes to disk. GhostLayer v0.4.0 for Windows.

metadata.title: What’s next | The Proof Foundry
metadata.description: Current public software releases, candidate builds and development plans at The Proof Foundry.
